}}'''Moriarty''' is an NPC in {{location|Ragunna}}, found in [[Bank Street]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Moriarty:''' We will leave in ten minutes!
:{{DIcon}} Where are we headed?
:'''Moriarty:''' To the vault, of course.
:'''Moriarty:''' Hi there! I'm Moriarty, an employee at Averardo Bank. The Echo train will be loaded in ten minutes, and I need to make sure these treasures get transported safely.
:'''Moriarty:''' You've probably seen those Echo trains gliding through the Nimbus Sanctum, right? They're responsible for delivering treasures for the Montelli family's bank and vault.
:'''Moriarty:''' But enough chit-chat! It's time for my prayer!
:{{DIcon}} Prayer? Are you part of the Order?
:'''Moriarty:''' Not exactly! I just pray that I get to record the song when we are in Nimbus Sanctum during this trip.
:{{DIcon}} A song?
:'''Moriarty:''' Yeah! Sometimes when I'm riding through the Nimbus Sanctum, I can hear this beautiful song coming from the water.
:'''Moriarty:''' It's hauntingly sad, unlike anything I've ever heard, so I want to use my recording device to capture it for everyone to enjoy.
:'''Moriarty:''' But here's the thing: after the train leaves the Nimbus Sanctum, the song will just disappear, leaving only static noise in the recorder.
:'''Moriarty:''' I've been wondering lately... could it be that the Lorelei in Nimbus Sanctum doesn't want that song to be shared with more people?
{{Dialogue End}}
